<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most plausible molecular formula that matches the observed m/z 141.115364 (interpreted as [M+H]⁺) is C₅H₁₇O₄, which gives a calculated monoisotopic mass of 141.112685 Da (≈19 ppm error, acceptable for the data).</thought>
<final_answer>C5H17O4</final_answer>
